required_external_gate.name: ROOT_ACTUAL_COMMIT_PR_CHAIN_GATE
requirements: Actual source commit parent equals actual publication base; actual source tree matches.
Actual merged PR head equals source commit, merged=true, merge method merge, merge_commit_sha equals tested main.
Actual tested main commit parents contain source and actual main tree matches.
Root must bind actual saved source/main commit API and merged PR JSON; fields are mandatory, not optional.

limitations: This static result verifies the book layer only, not an actual remote release.
Root actual mandatory commit/PR-chain gate, both real CI runs, all saved tree/inventory reconciliations and current local book acceptance must exist before remote prepare/apply.
A later helper change requires a diff review; root integration helper will be reviewed separately when available.
